display.purpose: Hero statements only, uppercase, poster-scale. One per page.

body.purpose: Product description, story copy, checkout copy. Max 65-75ch.

label.purpose: Nav, buttons, size-selector, form labels. Uppercase, 0.1em tracking.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Default easing for all state transitions (hover, focus, selection). No bounce, no elastic.

motion.name: duration-panel
motion.purpose: Mobile nav panel, cart drawer open/close (grid-template-rows / transform only, never height).

motion.name: duration-reveal
motion.purpose: Staggered fade-up of hero content on first load, 60-180ms delay per element.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action: Add to Cart, Checkout, Place Order.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #A8402F; color: #F6EFE4; font-family: Jost, 'Avenir Next', Futura, 'Century Gothic', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.4; padding: 16px 32px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #7C2D21; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2B211E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-emphasis actions: Continue Shopping, View Details.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #2B211E; font-family: Jost, 'Avenir Next', Futura, 'Century Gothic', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.4; padding: 16px 32px; border: 1px solid #E3D6C2; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #E3D6C2; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2B211E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Size Selector
components.description: Signature component: the 100g/250g/500g pack-size picker. Always three horizontal segments, never a dropdown, minimum 48px touch height. Typically sits inside a solid Sand section, so unselected options are White to pop against it.
components.css: .ds-size-selector { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-size-option { flex: 1; min-height: 48px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #2B211E; border: 1px solid #E3D6C2; border-radius: 10px; font-family: Jost, 'Avenir Next', Futura, 'Century Gothic', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-size-option:hover { border-color: #A8402F; } .ds-size-option:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-size-option--selected, .ds-size-option[aria-checked='true'] { background: #A8402F; color: #F6EFE4; border-color: #A8402F; } .ds-size-option:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2B211E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Product Section Block
components.description: The primary conversion moment: a solid, full-strength Sand section with a White panel nested inside it for the price/CTA area. Flat, shadow-free; contrast comes from real colour, not a tonal blend.
components.html:
Raw Red Rooibos

Organic, unpasteurised, small-batch.
components.css: .ds-block { background: #E3D6C2; padding: 32px; border-radius: 16px; } .ds-block-inner { background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 10px; padding: 20px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Jost, 'Avenir Next', Futura, 'Century Gothic', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; color: #2B211E; margin: 0; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Jost, 'Avenir Next', Futura, 'Century Gothic', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.65; color: #2B211E; margin: 0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { background: #FFFFFF; color: #2B211E; border: 1px solid #E3D6C2; border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: Jost, 'Avenir Next', Futura, 'Century Gothic', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; width: 100%; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #A8402F; border-width: 2px; padding: 11px 15px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #827973; }

narrative.overview: The mark is a red circle: read one way it's a cup of rooibos seen from above, read another it's a sun low on the horizon. Everything in this system takes its cue from that ambiguity, a single warm, saturated color that means something precisely because it's rare. The canvas is White: crisp, bright, and undecorated, so the earth tones (Rooibos Red, Warm Sand, Deep Russet) read as deliberate pops of colour rather than blending into a beige haze. This is a Restrained strategy for the accent combined with solid colour-blocking for the neutrals: Sand appears as a genuine full-strength section background, not a tint. The brand rejects the clinical feel of a wellness-supplement brand, the generic badge-cluttered look of an off-the-shelf Shopify template, and murky blended near-white backgrounds that all read as the same beige.
keyCharacteristics: White is the dominant canvas across the whole site (nav, hero, footer, most body copy)
Rooibos Red stays rare and dedicated to CTAs, price emphasis, and short accent text
Warm Sand is used as a genuine full-strength solid colour block for one or two sections per page, never a faded tint
White panels nest inside Sand sections (and vice versa) for contrast-on-contrast instead of shadows
Flat surfaces always: no gradients, no drop shadows, no glassmorphism
A single geometric sans family (Jost, standing in for the licensed Futura PT / Avenir Next) carries the whole system
Real photography of tea, leaf, and harvest, never a colored block standing in for an image
A staggered fade-up on first load and scale(0.97) press feedback on every interactive element

rules.name: The Steeped Sun Rule
rules.body: Rooibos Red never exceeds roughly 12% of a screen's surface. If a layout needs more visual weight, add whitespace or a larger photograph before reaching for more red.

rules.name: The Solid Block Rule
rules.body: When Sand is used as a section or panel background, it runs at full, undiluted strength, never a faded opacity tint. Nest a White panel inside a Sand block (or vice versa) for contrast, rather than reaching for a shadow.

rules.name: The Branded Label Rule
rules.body: The logo's own extreme tracking (0.33em on the wordmark, 0.42em on its tagline) belongs to the literal brand mark only. Everyday uppercase UI tracks at a legible 0.1em.

rules.name: The Flat Sunlight Rule
rules.body: No drop shadows, gradients, or soft tonal blending anywhere. Depth and rhythm come from alternating genuine solid colours (White, Sand) section by section.

dos: Do keep Rooibos Red to roughly 10-12% of any screen (the Steeped Sun Rule)
Do use White as the default canvas and Sand at full strength for accent sections (the Solid Block Rule)
Do ship real rooibos/tea photography for hero and story sections
Do reserve the wordmark's extreme letter-spacing for the literal logo and tagline only
Do keep every interactive target at least 44x44px (48px for the size selector)
Do maintain WCAG AA contrast for Rooibos Red and Fireside Ink text
Do execute familiar ecommerce conventions with this system's warmth and craft
donts: Don't add box-shadow to cards, buttons, or the nav bar
Don't use gradients, radial washes, or soft-shading effects anywhere
Don't use a faded/tinted opacity of Sand as a section background; full strength or not at all
Don't use border-left / border-right as a colored accent stripe
Don't use gradient text or decorative glassmorphism panels
Don't set body copy in all-caps
Don't default to a generic Shopify-template layout
Don't use em dashes in interface copy
Don't use pure black (#000) anywhere; pure White is the deliberate canvas exception
